findings.detail: 134 observation rawRecords equal the corrected-source JSON-pointer target. The 135th is the deliberate supplementary lock-to-lock printed declaration: its pointer refers to the normalized-null source record, while rawRecord contains rowLabel and printedValue from the hashed, line-anchored guide. It is not a normalized steering-turns value; the required lock issue and canonical null remain. Treat sourceBoundary.rawRecordSHA256 as a hash of the embedded record, not as proof of pointer equality for this supplementary observation.
